title: Wave of Hoax Bomb Threats to Flights in Europe Leaves Travelers Frustrated
summary_full: Bomb threats have disrupted dozens of flights in Europe over the past week. At airports in Rome, Madrid and Warsaw, travelers were more frustrated than fearful.
